# Israel Private Van

> Private van and driver service across Israel, run by Amir Levi Transportation Services Ltd. (אמיר לוי שירותי הסעות בע"מ) of Holon, Israel. Over 30 years on the road and more than 200 regular customers. Ben Gurion airport transfers, a van and driver by the day, private day tours, and transport for weddings, events, businesses, delegations and touring artists. Drivers speak Hebrew, English and Russian. One price for the whole van, not per person.

- Phone and WhatsApp: +972 52 525 1806
- Email: info@israelprivatevan.com
- Vehicles: Mercedes-Benz Sprinter and Savanna passenger vans, 2024 to 2026 models, 12 to 15 passenger seats depending on the van
- Hours: 24/7, including nights, Shabbat and Jewish holidays
- Area served: all of Israel, including every seaport (Haifa, Ashdod, Eilat) and every land border crossing (Allenby, Jordan River, Yitzhak Rabin, Taba)
- Airport pickups: the van waits at the Ben Gurion arrivals exit; flights are tracked and the driver arrives for the actual landing time
- Flights out: we recommend being at Ben Gurion 3 hours before an international departure
- Child seats: available at extra charge
- Prices: quoted per trip for the whole van (not per person), on request via WhatsApp; no public price list because prices depend on route, time and group size
- Languages of the site: English (/), Hebrew (/he/), Russian (/ru/)
